import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";

export default function AlertDialogDemo() {
  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Show Dialog</Button>} />
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your
            data from our servers.
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction>Continue</AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
import CircleFadingPlusIcon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/CircleFadingPlusIcon";

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogMedia,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";

export function AlertDialogWithMedia() {
  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Share Project</Button>} />
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogMedia>
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={CircleFadingPlusIcon} />
          </AlertDialogMedia>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Share this project?</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            Anyone with the link will be able to view and edit this project.
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction>Share</AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
import BluetoothIcon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/BluetoothIcon";

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogMedia,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";

export function AlertDialogSmallWithMedia() {
  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Show Dialog</Button>} />

      <AlertDialogContent size="sm">
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogMedia>
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={BluetoothIcon} />
          </AlertDialogMedia>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Allow accessory to connect?</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            Do you want to allow the USB accessory to connect to this device?
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Don't allow</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction>Allow</AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";

const Example = (args: { size: "default" | "sm"; defaultOpen: boolean }) => (
  <AlertDialog key={String(args.defaultOpen)} defaultOpen={args.defaultOpen}>
    <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Open alert dialog</Button>} />
    <AlertDialogContent size={args.size}>
      <AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogTitle>Confirm action</AlertDialogTitle>
        <AlertDialogDescription>This action needs confirmation.</AlertDialogDescription>
      </AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogFooter>
        <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
        <AlertDialogAction>Continue</AlertDialogAction>
      </AlertDialogFooter>
    </AlertDialogContent>
  </AlertDialog>
);

export default Example;
